programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Between the world we see and the things we fear…There are doors. When they are opened...Nightmares become reality. These are the true stories of the innocent and the unimaginable.

programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team finishes their investigation into the Old Hospital on College Hill, deep in the Appalachian Mountains, a place steeped in a long history of hauntings where shadowy presences, unexplained phenomena, and whispers of unknown evils linger in the darkness, waiting to be discovered. What will they encounter in the shadows—and will they leave unchanged?

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: New Jersey police working the murder of a woman bludgeoned to death in her own bed first think her boyfriend did it. When a desperate family member contacts renowned psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, Nancy sees the boyfriend is innocent, and gives police details that help undo the real killer's alibi. New Orleans investigators are stumped when a young mother turns up beaten to death, her son gravely injured. The suspects-the husband and his friend-blame each other, so investigators turn to psychic Rosemarie Kerr. Tapping into the fallen wife's vibration, Rosemarie discovers a truth more horrifying than anyone imagined.

programme.title: Encounters
programme.desc: After 5 years, Jason returns to the scene of the first location the Encounters crew ever investigated.....Bodmin Jail as his investigation of this mammoth prison alone once again, begins!

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: An investigation into the practice of past-life regression therapy; a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover memories of supposed past lives. In this episode, a young woman anxious to learn why she is afraid to have children travels back to 19th-century, rural America where she re-experiences a tragic loss

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files
programme.desc: The team at Virginia Paranormal Investigations travels the state investigating claims of paranormal activity and compiling the Virginia Paranormal Case Files. The show offers a balanced look at paranormal investigation. VAPI has a reputation for being honest and approaching each case with an open mind. The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.
